nodes.name: Query Webhook
nodes.notes: POST {"sql":"SELECT ..."}. For standalone testing. Workflow must be Active for the /webhook/ URL.

nodes.name: When Executed by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Makes this callable as a TOOL by the agent. Declares one input: sql (a read-only SELECT). Returns { rowCount, rows } to the caller.

nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: One clean 'sql' whichever trigger fired: webhook sends body.sql, the agent tool sends sql.

nodes.name: Run Query
nodes.notes: Runs the guarded SELECT using the agent_readonly credential (SELECT-only). Never use the read-WRITE credential here.

nodes.name: Webhook Call?
nodes.notes: Webhook run -> Respond; agent tool run -> just return the data to the caller.

nodes.name: Return to Caller
nodes.notes: Terminal node when called as a tool. Its { rowCount, rows } output is what the agent receives.
